Definition: to be dumb; by implication, to be astonished, to stop; also to perish
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be silent, be still, wait, be dumb, grow dumb; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be silent; 1a2) to be still, die; 1a3) to be struck dumb; 1b) (Niphal) to be silenced, be made silent, destroyed; 1c) (Poal) to make quiet; 1d) (Hiphil) to make silent (cause to die)
